name: Rob2628
noteEs: Rob2628 es el creator de D4 más prolífico en YouTube — postea múltiples videos por día cubriendo builds, theorycraft, speedfarming y patch reactions. Su content tiene tono enérgico y se enfoca en optimization endgame. Cuando sale balance change, Rob suele tener video analizando dentro de las primeras 24 horas. Para players que farmean activamente Pit y Helltides, su channel es referencia constante.
noteEn: Rob2628 is the most prolific D4 creator on YouTube — posts multiple videos a day covering builds, theorycraft, speedfarming, and patch reactions. His content has an energetic tone and focuses on endgame optimization. When a balance change drops, Rob usually has an analysis video out within the first 24 hours. For players actively farming Pit and Helltides, his channel is a constant reference.
highlightsEs: Cadencia diaria de uploads durante season activa
Builds optimizados para Pit pushing y speed farming
Patch reactions y meta calls dentro de 24h del balance change
Live streaming activo en Twitch complementa YouTube
Foco en endgame: poco contenido de leveling/newcomer
highlightsEn: Daily upload cadence during active season
Builds optimized for Pit pushing and speed farming
Patch reactions and meta calls within 24h of balance changes
